text:
ingrid: Hey team — starting ~2026-03-14T09:18:00Z our hosted inference requests (model=gpt-xl-8k) started returning 502/504 intermittently. Customer reports ~30% failure rate and timeouts. Example curl and response below, request-id: r-0a1b2c3d4e. Please triage, this is impacting a paying customer in EU region.

maria: ack-ingrid, sorry about that. Can you paste the raw response headers and full x-request-id? Also what endpoint and region (hosted-us vs hosted-eu)? I’ll pull control-plane logs.

ingrid: Pasting the exact output from their side: 
```
$ curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-xl-8k","input":"hello"}'

HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\n
Content-Type: application/json\n
X-Request-Id: r-0a1b2c3d4e\n
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2026 09:19:02 GMT\n
\n{"error":"control-plane: failed to fetch routing policy: timeout connecting to configdb"}
```

Region: hosted-eu (eu-west-1). Customer uses single org AcmeHealth.

maria: Thanks. I see a spike in control-plane errors starting 09:17 UTC. Poking logs now. @raj can you look at routing-policy and configdb shards for eu-west-1? I’m also seeing a few auth-session timeouts in the same window.

sre-bot: ALERT: control-plane/configdb-latency (eu-west-1) > 95th pct threshold. Spike detected at 2026-03-14T09:17:45Z — firing alert.

raj: On it. Correlating traces for request r-0a1b2c3d4e... I see the control-plane trace: routing-service tried to fetch policy for org AcmeHealth and hit configdb with request id cdb-9f8e7. ConfigDB returned timeout after 1.2s, then routing-service returned 502 to API gateway. From metrics: configdb connection pool exhausted on shard-3 (eu-west-1) around the same time.

sam: Noted. We had a rolling restart earlier this morning on controlplane-api nodes that may have temporarily reduced pool headroom. configdb shard-3 shows transient CPU + connection wait growth. Could be a retry storm from clients continually failing over.

maria: Repro steps for us to validate: 1) curl the hosted-eu endpoint with the same headers and include `X-RW-Trace: r-0a1b2c3d4e` to capture server-side trace. 2) Check the Console metrics page for control-plane > routing-policy > error-rate and configdb latency. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/AcmeHealth/metrics?service=control-plane (internal link).

ingrid: We ran the curl again a few times and attaching the new response (same pattern):
```
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout

{"error":"control-plane: routing-policy service timeout (upstream 504)"}
```

maria: OK that's consistent. Temporary mitigation options:
- If the customer can tolerate slightly stale routing rules, we can enable local cached routing on the edge for them (toggle `prefer_local_routing=true` on their org -> this bypasses configdb reads for routing policy).
- Increase per-org configdb connection limit for AcmeHealth for the next hour while we remediate.

raj: I can increase pool limit for shard-3 but that’s a short-term fix. Root cause looks like configdb experiencing high tail latency due to GC/compaction on one replica. I'm going to open a configdb failover to promote replica-2 and drain replica-3. Will update runbook steps in the incident.

sam: Also enabling conservative retry/backoff in routing-service will reduce load — moving retries from 3 -> 1 for the next 5 minutes for eu-west routing calls (config change `routing.retry.count = 1`). I’ll roll that now.

maria: For support response to customer I drafted this (can someone sign off):
"We saw a transient backend configuration database timeout in EU which caused the control plane to fail to fetch routing policy for a subset of requests. Our engineers are failing over the replica and applying temporary rate-limiting on internal retries to reduce pressure. We expect service to recover in ~15 minutes. As a temporary workaround, you can set `prefer_local_routing=true` in your request to avoid the control-plane routing lookup."

raj: Signed. Also adding: request ids r-0a1b2c3d4e and cdb-9f8e7 to the incident.

maria: Patch applied: `routing.retry.count` -> 1 in eu-west config (rolled to 3/3 nodes), and we triggered replica failover on configdb shard-3 at 09:26 UTC. Monitoring now.

sre-bot: NOTE: configdb/shard-3 promoted replica-2 at 2026-03-14T09:27:14Z. Health checks passing.

ingrid: Thanks — customer reports errors dropped to ~1-2% after 09:30 UTC. They still saw a couple of 502s but says traffic is much healthier.

maria: Great. Follow-ups:
- eng-runtime to investigate compaction timing on replica-3 (possible tuning).
- product to review whether a per-org circuit-breaker (prevent retry storms) is reasonable.
- support to notify customer when incident closes and offer 12 hour service credit if they want.

sam: Filing ENG issue ENG-RT-2026-342 for compaction tuning.

raj: Incident created: INC-2026-045 (control-plane configdb latency eu-west-1). Taking lead. Will post RCA in postmortems channel after root cause is validated.

maria: Closing the support thread with summary to customer; will keep the incident open internally. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
